evidenceAvailability: Full bundle retained in the named local run directory, not published central evidence. This report retains lossless stdout/stderr/observable snapshots; compiler binaries remain in the full bundle.
selection: Bounded first slice: 19 original scenarios plus 32 inspected upstream leads, not a full Node test inventory or upstream test-suite port.

license.notice: Node.js contributors; some inspected files retain Joyent notices. Exact upstream license bytes are content-identified here. No upstream code is redistributed: all executable fixtures in this slice are original JROC-project code.

upstream.note: Upstream files are discovery leads, not executed/ported cases. Their classifications never contribute to scenario outcome counts.

inventory.note: Mappings indicate selected assertion intent, not whole-API support or proof every mapped operation was reached. Unmapped APIs are untested by this slice; compile/runtime failures can prevent mapped operations from executing.
